title: Snail holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d="M70 30 Q65 45 62 55" stroke="#F5E6A8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="22" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#FF5E7E"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="17" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFA3B5"/>
  <polygon points="68,33 72,33 70,37" fill="#FF5E7E"/>
  <!-- snail body -->
  <path d="M15 75 Q15 65 25 63 L55 63 Q65 63 68 70 Q70 75 62 78 L22 78 Q15 78 15 75 Z" fill="#8ED17A"/>
  <!-- snail foot shadow -->
  <path d="M15 78 Q18 85 30 85 L58 85 Q68 85 68 78 Z" fill="#5FA84E"/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="18" fill="#E8A94D"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="14" fill="#F7C96B"/>
  <path d="M40 41 A14 14 0 0 1 54 55 A14 14 0 0 1 40 69 A14 14 0 0 1 26 55 A14 14 0 0 1 40 41" fill="none" stroke="#D18B2E" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <path d="M40 48 A7 7 0 0 1 47 55 A7 7 0 0 1 40 62 A7 7 0 0 1 33 55 A7 7 0 0 1 40 48" fill="none" stroke="#D18B2E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <path d="M32 46 Q36 42 41 43" stroke="#FFE3A3" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- snail head -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="64" r="8" fill="#A8E090"/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <path d="M58 58 Q56 48 59 45" stroke="#8ED17A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 58 Q68 48 65 45" stroke="#8ED17A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="59" cy="44" r="3" fill="#3D7D2E"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="44" r="3" fill="#3D7D2E"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="43.5" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="43.5" r="1.2" fill="#fff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M59 68 Q62 71 65 68" stroke="#3D7D2E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- balloon-holding arm -->
  <path d="M66 68 Q70 62 72 56" stroke="#8ED17A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little hand -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#A8E090"/>
</svg>
